text: CONTROL failure (twice, attempts 2 and 3): autocal's test road landed on the empty zoo lot (112,59). build.py now clears road and rubble tiles inside a plant/station/recreation footprint before placing it; the new road-network audit caught the stray.

CONTROL: autocal test roads twice landed on planned tiles in attempt 3 (a zone tile, then a power-line tile at (37,64), cutting the line). build.py now removes any new road tile not planned as road, and re-places a line that a stray road replaced; the road-network audit catches the rest.

Nov 2012 CONTROL failures: (1) built the west shops before west district 2 (wrong order; the road-network audit caught it); (2) build.py clicks landed 2-4 rows off near the north-west of the west bank (autocal calibrated far from the view centre there), leaving road gaps under line crossings and stray roads on lines. Fixed by hand, checking each tile in the save. Next: make autocal refuse a calibration tile far from the requested centre.

CONTROL failure (my own fix's bug): the stray-road cleanup added in attempt 3 treated new road/line crossings as strays (their last plan step is the line) and bulldozed them, leaving road gaps in west2, w3 and east2. Now any tile a plan's road step covers is kept. All gaps were fixed by hand and checked in the save.
